page_title: AST 3-1 CRY | Aston Villa v Crystal Palace 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+18' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+15' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
90+14' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
90+13' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is penalised for holding. Darren England signals a set piece.

90+10' 3 - 1 Goal! Moussa Diaby plays in Leon Bailey (Aston Villa), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders. He shoots from inside the box into the right side of the net! Great finish - 3:1.
90+10' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Leander Dendoncker (Aston Villa) replaces Ollie Watkins.
90+10' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jesuran Rak-Sakyi (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Cheick Doucoure cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+8' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+8' 2 - 1 Goal! Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Sam Johnstone to commit before slotting the penalty into the left of the goal.
90+8' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) is going to take the penalty!
90+7' Referee Darren England is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Aston Villa!
90+4' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Aston Villa as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.

90+4' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Aston Villa are awarded a penalty kick!
90+3' The ball is cleared after Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' We are about to witness a subsitution. Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) for Odsonne Edouard.
89' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is behind the touchline and Aston Villa will take a throw-in.

88' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) scores with a brilliant shot into the top left corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Lucas Digne. The score is now 1:1.
86' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren England had an easy-decision to make.
84' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.

83' What an opportunity! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the roof of the net, but Emiliano Martinez reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
82' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) plays a through ball but overhits it.
81' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
81' Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
78' Sam Johnstone (Crystal Palace) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Aston Villa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
77' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the right post!
75' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Sam Johnstone.
72' Great ball in from Joachim Andersen. Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker wide of the left post.
71' The referee signals a substitution. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for John McGinn.
71' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
71' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace). It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.
70' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace).

69' Crystal Palace slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
67' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
66' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) dribbles into the box, but Emiliano Martinez is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.

63' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) latched on to an accurate cross inside the box and attempted to direct the ball with a nice header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep the ball out.
58' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo will be replaced by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa).
57' The substitution is prepared. Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Boubacar Kamara.
57' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
56' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

56' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
55' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Crystal Palace comes to nothing.
55' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Sam Johnstone intercepts the ball.
52' Wonderful movement by Aston Villa. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
50' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.

48' 0 - 1 Jean-Philippe Mateta produces a sweet pass and picks out Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the middle of the net and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 0:1!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' This is a yellow card! Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
45+2' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Darren England interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
44' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
43' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
43' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) will take a corner kick.

42' That's unlucky! Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Crystal Palace get a corner.
41' Odsonne Edouard (Crystal Palace) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
40' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
39' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) misses an absolute sitter after connecting with a cross inside the penalty box.
38' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
38' A pass by Matty Cash (Aston Villa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
36' The goal by Aston Villa is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
34' It's in the back of the net! Pau Torres plays it into the box, and Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
34' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) plays a through ball but overhits it.
34' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.

33' Aston Villa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
31' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) will take the free kick.
31' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
30' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) attempts to test the goalkeeper after receiving a cross inside the penalty area. He hits the ball poorly and his shot goes well wide of the right post.
27' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Darren England has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
26' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
25' Jordan Ayew just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) replaces him.
24' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
24' A pass from Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Sam Johnstone and the move breaks down.
23' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked.
23' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Looks like Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
19' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
19' Sam Johnstone pulls off a great save to deny Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
17' John McGinn (Aston Villa) has tested the patience of referee Darren England and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
17' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.

17' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
13' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a throw-in.
11' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Darren England stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
11' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
10' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Sam Johnstone comes off the line to clear the ball away.
9' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
7' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
7' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' Boubacar Kamara (Aston Villa) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle.

2' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Crystal Palace will take the kick-off.
Darren England is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
